basic_details.short_information: Vasai Virar City Municipal Corporation (VVCMC) has released the VVCMC Recruitment 2026 Notification for 156 Group C vacancies across 18 technical and non-technical post categories. The recruitment includes Junior Engineer, Clerk Typist, Electrician, Surveyor, Assistant Law Officer, Leading Fireman and other municipal corporation posts.

content_sections.heading: VVCMC Vacancy 2026 – Post-Wise Details
content_sections.text: VVCMC has announced 156 vacancies across 18 post categories. Junior Engineer (Civil) and Clerk Typist account for 50 vacancies each, making them the largest recruitment categories in the current notification. The advertised vacancy numbers and reservation distribution are subject to revision by the municipal corporation. Any changes will be published through the official VVCMC website. A total of 59 Junior Engineer vacancies are available across Civil, Electrical and Mechanical Engineering disciplines.

content_sections.heading: VVCMC Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The educational qualification and experience requirements vary according to the advertised post. Candidates must possess the prescribed qualifications and relevant experience within the period specified in the official notification. Knowledge of the Marathi language is required for the advertised posts. The above table summarizes the post-wise qualifications. Candidates applying for positions with experience requirements or revised qualifications must refer to the detailed eligibility provisions in the official notification.

rows.educational_qualification_and_experience: Diploma in Electrical Engineering or equivalent branch with 3 years of relevant experience, or a degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent branch.
Diploma in Mechanical or Automobile Engineering with 3 years of relevant experience, or a degree in Mechanical or Automobile Engineering.
Diploma in Civil Engineering with 3 years of relevant experience, or a degree in Civil Engineering. Revised qualification is subject to Government approval.
B.Sc. in Horticulture, Agriculture, Botany or Forestry from a recognized agricultural university, or a recognized degree in Botany.
M.Sc. in Chemistry, Microbiology or Environmental Science with 2 years of experience in water purification and chemical testing of water. Revised qualification is subject to Government approval.
SSC or HSC pass with a recognized ITI tracing/drafting or equivalent course certificate.

Diploma in Civil Engineering, or SSC with a recognized two-year ITI Surveyor certificate. Marathi typing at 30 WPM and English typing at 40 WPM are also required. Revised qualification is subject to Government approval.
SSC pass with an Electrician trade certificate from a Government-recognized Industrial Training Institute.
Minimum HSC pass. Preference is given to degree holders, particularly Science graduates, and candidates with Sanitation Inspector experience.
Bachelor's degree in Library Science (B.Lib.). Preference for M.Lib. holders and candidates with relevant institutional experience.
SSC pass with Marathi typing at 30 WPM or English typing at 40 WPM, along with MS-CIT or an accepted DOEACC computer qualification.
Law degree with at least 5 years of relevant judicial work experience in a Government, semi-Government or local self-government institution, or 5 years of legal practice in a Sessions Court.
Recognized degree with Statistics as a subject. Preference for postgraduate qualification in Statistics and relevant experience.

Degree in Chemistry or Microbiology with the prescribed DMLT qualification, or postgraduate degree in Microbiology or Chemistry. Preference for candidates with 3 years of relevant chemical analysis experience.
B.Sc. with Chemistry and 3 years of experience operating a filter water treatment plant. Revised qualification is subject to Government approval.
Graduate degree with one of the prescribed fire service qualifications, MS-CIT, relevant service experience and physical fitness.
Graduate degree with the prescribed Fire Engineering qualification, advanced fire service diploma or professional membership, MS-CIT and relevant officer-level fire service experience.
SSC pass, six-month Fireman training course from the Maharashtra State Fire Training Centre, MS-CIT and at least 5 years of prescribed fire service experience.

A graduate degree is not specified as a mandatory educational qualification for the Clerk Typist post. Candidates must, however, possess the prescribed typing and computer proficiency certificates.

content_sections.heading: VVCMC Recruitment 2026 Apply Online
content_sections.text: The online registration process for VVCMC Group C Recruitment 2026 is scheduled to commence on 26 November 2026. Eligible candidates must submit their applications through the official municipal corporation website before 11:55 PM on 17 December 2026. VVCMC Recruitment 2026 Apply Online – Official Website Applications submitted through offline or other unauthorized methods will not be accepted. Candidates should ensure that their examination fee payment has been successfully completed before the deadline. Visit the official Vasai Virar City Municipal Corporation website at www.vvcmc.in . Locate the Group C direct recruitment notification dated 25 November 2026. Read the post-wise qualifications, experience requirements and reservation conditions. Open the online application registration facility. Complete registration using a valid email address and mobile number. Log in using the generated credentials and complete your candidate profile. Enter personal details, contact information, educational qualifications and applicable experience. Select the relevant post and enter the required reservation details. Upload the photograph, signature and applicable supporting documents. Verify all entered details carefully before submitting the application. Pay the applicable examination fee through the online payment gateway. Complete final submission and download the application form and payment e-receipt. Although application information may be available in Marathi and English, candidates must complete the application in English as instructed in the notification. Full names and addresses should be entered without unnecessary abbreviations.

content_sections.heading: VVCMC Application Form 2026 Photo and Signature Specifications
content_sections.text: Candidates must upload a recent photograph and clear signature according to the specifications provided in the recruitment notification. The photograph should have been taken within six months before the application date. Candidates must ensure that uploaded images are clear and correctly displayed before final submission.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for VVCMC Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should keep their educational, personal, professional and reservation-related documents ready before completing the application. SSC certificate or school leaving certificate as applicable proof of age. HSC certificate and mark sheet, where applicable. ITI, Diploma, Graduate or Postgraduate qualification certificates and mark sheets. Relevant work experience certificates. Marathi or English typing certificate, as prescribed for the selected post. MS-CIT or accepted computer qualification certificate. Maharashtra domicile certificate, where applicable. Caste certificate and caste validity certificate, where applicable. Non-Creamy Layer certificate, where applicable. EWS certificate, where applicable. Disability certificate and UDID Card, where applicable. Ex-servicemen, sports, orphan or other horizontal reservation certificates, where applicable. Recent photograph and signature. Valid Government-issued photo identity proof. Marriage certificate or Gazette notification supporting a name change, where applicable. During document verification, candidates must produce the applicable original documents along with two self-attested copies as specified in the notification. Candidates who fail to establish their eligibility may be disqualified from selection.

content_sections.heading: VVCMC Admit Card 2026
content_sections.text: The VVCMC Group C recruitment admit card will be made available seven days before the online examination. The examination date, time and centre will be mentioned on the admit card. Candidates will be informed about the admit card download facility through their registered email addresses or mobile numbers. Applicants should regularly check the official website for examination-related announcements. The notification also requires candidates to retain their examination fee e-receipt and bring the relevant copy along with the admit card as instructed.

content_sections.heading: VVCMC Recruitment 2026 Application Correction Rules
content_sections.text: Candidates must carefully verify their personal details, qualifications, experience and reservation claims before final submission. The recruitment notification states that changes to submitted application details will not be permitted subsequently. No separate application correction window has been announced in the supplied notification.

content_sections.heading: VVCMC Recruitment 2026 Helpdesk
content_sections.text: For technical difficulties during online registration, candidates should use the technical support facility specified in the official notification or displayed on the application portal.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available under VVCMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Vasai Virar City Municipal Corporation has announced 156 Group C vacancies across 18 technical and non-technical post categories, including Junior Engineer, Clerk Typist, Electrician and Leading Fireman posts.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for VVCMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the VVCMC online application form is 17 December 2026 at 11:55 PM. The examination fee must also be paid within the prescribed application period.

faq.question: Q3. When does VVCMC Recruitment 2026 apply online start?
faq.answer: The online application process is scheduled to commence on 26 November 2026 through the official Vasai Virar City Municipal Corporation website at vvcmc.in.

faq.question: Q4. How many Junior Engineer vacancies are available in VVCMC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 59 Junior Engineer vacancies are available, including 50 Civil Engineering, 7 Electrical Engineering and 2 Mechanical Engineering posts.

faq.question: Q5. Can 10th-pass candidates apply for VVCMC Clerk Typist Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Yes. SSC or Class 10 pass candidates can apply for Clerk Typist posts if they also possess the prescribed Marathi or English typing certificate, computer qualification and Marathi language proficiency.

faq.question: Q6. What is the VVCMC Clerk Typist salary?
faq.answer: The advertised salary for VVCMC Clerk Typist posts is Rs. 19,900 to Rs. 63,200 under Pay Level S-6 of the 7th Pay Commission.

faq.question: Q7. Can engineering graduates without experience apply for VVCMC Junior Engineer posts?
faq.answer: The notification provides a relevant engineering degree pathway without specifying a separate mandatory experience period. Diploma holders must possess three years of relevant experience. Revised Civil Junior Engineer qualifications are subject to Government approval.
